geometry.locator: Derived from geometry:fermilab-bnb-target; candidate OSM ways/1423112777,1423112778, extract timestamp 2026-09-18
geometry.note: Accuracy is set to 30 m to cover the ~17 m scatter between the two candidate footprints, on top of the usual OpenStreetMap and derivation uncertainty. A source naming the specific building would allow it to be drawn as a hall polygon.

method: Point placed 110 m upstream of geometry:fermilab-bnb-target's downstream bearing continuation, i.e. at the sourced 110 m SBND baseline (src:sbnd-detector-paper-2025) along the derived BNB axis. Two OSM building footprints sit near this ideal point but neither is confidently identified as SBND specifically: way 1423112777 (span ~34 m, 17.2 m from the ideal point) and way 1423112778 (span ~10 m, 17.7 m from the ideal point) -- almost equally good positional matches, no OSM tag names either, and no source consulted (checked 2026-09-18) distinguishes them. `feature_type` is `target_station` (a labelled point) rather than the real building footprint because the specific footprint is not confidently identified; drawing either candidate polygon as 'SBND' would overstate certainty.
name: SBND (derived position; candidate footprint not confirmed)
notes: The feature type is 'other' (corrected on 2026-09-21 from target_station): this is a derived detector position, not a beam target.

summary.plain: A derived point for the SBND detector, 110 m along the Booster Neutrino Beam axis from the derived target. Two nearby building footprints are almost equally good matches, so no building is drawn.
